title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: A legendary wizard recounts his extraordinary life in his own words — his childhood in a troupe of traveling players, his years at a renowned university, and his pursuit of the truth about the mysterious force that killed his family.

title: Station Eleven
author: Emily St. John Mandel
description: After a flu pandemic destroys civilization, a traveling theater company performs Shakespeare across the Great Lakes region, weaving together the stories of survivors connected to a famous actor who died the night the world ended.

title: Pachinko
author: Min Jin Lee
description: An epic saga following four generations of a Korean family who immigrate to Japan, tracing their struggles with identity, discrimination, love, and sacrifice across the twentieth century.
